K3 — Skilled Craft

June 2, 2023 – September 30, 2026

Effective November 2, 2020, Teamsters Local 2010 was certified by the Public Employment Relations Board (PERB) as the exclusive bargaining agent for the K3 skilled trades unit at Davis.

This inaugural contract was ratified on June 1, 2023 and will be effective June 2, 2023 to September 30, 2026.

CM — Communications, Marketing, and Sales Professionals

Home About Contract News

The University of California employs approximately 1,616 communications, marketing and sales professionals who contribute to UC’s mission by producing and sharing information about the University’s services, programs, priorities and mission. This includes managing the UC brand, supporting the user experience, and connecting with a wide variety of audiences through content, storytelling and outreach.

By coordinating strategy across platforms and topics, they help strengthen trust and highlight the university’s contributions at the state, national and global levels.

Individuals in the following titles are in this systemwide bargaining unit:

  • Acquisitions Editor
  • Communications Specialist
  • Digital Communications Specialist
  • Marketing Specialist
  • Media Communications Specialist
  • Program Representative
  • Publications Production Specialist
  • Sales Specialist
  • Visual Communications Specialist
  • Writer/Editor

This is a newly formed unit, and negotiations for the new contract began in May 2026.

SV — Student Services and Advising Professionals

Home About Contract News

The University of California employs about 4,238 student services and advising professionals (SSAP) who contribute to the academic community by providing student services in various areas, including academic advising, registrar, financial aid, and admissions. UC’s student services and advising professionals bring expertise and creativity that enrich the academic and campus environment for all members of the UC community, including graduate and undergraduate students.

The International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America (UAW) exclusively represents student services and advising professionals at UC.

RP — Research and Public Service Professionals

Home About Contract News

The University of California employs about 6,249 research and public service professionals (RPSP) across the UC system. Some work in data collection and analysis; others manage research and public service programs, including grant administration. Some work in research centers and institutes, while others are in academic departments and labs.

The International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America (UAW) exclusively represents research and public service professionals at UC.
